narr: Low level moisture was plentiful across northern Arizona with surface dewpoints in the 50s to low 60s. Instability was highest along/south of the Mogollon Rim, with mean MUCAPE from HREF at 1000-1500 J/kg in Yavapai County in the afternoon. General storm motion toward was to the east at 10-15 MPH with light low level flow.
ev: A river gauge on Black Canyon Creek showed a rise from 1.8 feet to 3.4 feet between 205 PM and 321 PM. A video on social media at 342 PM showed water rapidly flowing over Maren Avenue at a low water crossing on Black Canyon Creek.

The stream gauge on the Big Bug Creek in Mayer showed a rise from 1.9 to 4.9 feet in about 40 minutes starting at noon. The flood water over topped the Spring Lane bridge over Big Bug Creek in Spring Valley at 130 PM. A video on social media showed water flowing over a low water crossing on Thunderbird Trail in Cordes Junction at 155 PM. A river gauge on the Agua Fria River just downstream from the confluence with the Big Bug Creek showed a rise from 3.7 feet to 7.9 feet between 200 PM to 300 PM.
